text:
marta: Heads-up - pen test next Wed. We need a slim evidence kit for the retest: RBAC delta, audit slice, KMS usage manifest, session policy, and a short repro for any auth failures. Can we agree minimal deliverables and ownership?

sam: I can do RBAC delta + session policy. Minimal RBAC artifact = terraform plan diff (text) + CSV of grants. CSV fields: principal,role,grant_ts,expires_ts,method. I'll include the commit SHA and the rollout change-id.

li: I'll export the audit topic window. Proposal: 30m before -> 30m after the test window (configurable). Output gzipped, sha256 checksum, and an internal presign URL. Export command we use:```bash
kubectl -n observability exec svc/kafka-exporter -- kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic audit-events-prod --offsets 0 --max-messages 200000 | gzip > /tmp/audit-4890123456.gz
```

ellen: KMS: we cannot hand out CMK material. We'll produce a key-usage manifest (key_id, op, ts, requester) and an HMAC-signed metadata blob. If assessors need to validate a decrypt call, provide wrapping metadata (ciphertext header) but redact plaintext.

neha: For repros, keep it tiny. One-liner curl with the exact token and endpoint stubbed (use <redacted-token>). Also include expected vs observed status/code. Example:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/auth/assume" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"role":"roles/pt-assessor"}'
```

marta: Sam, can you paste a tiny sample of that RBAC CSV here?

sam: sure, sample:```csv
principal,role,grant_ts,expires_ts,method
user:alice,roles/pt-assessor,1710000000,1710003600,assume-role
svc:kgmt,roles/keystore-reader,1710000500,1710004100,service-account
```

li: After upload I will run two sanity checks: checksum verification and gzip header. Pen-test upload hooks will reject if signatures or checksums don't match. I'll also scrub IP addresses from tcpdump captures if we include any network traces.

ellen: We'll add a session-policy.json that was injected at time of the test (explicit inline session policy). That should make permission repro deterministic.

marta: pen-test-bot 1 can you confirm the S3 prefix naming and the upload validation steps?

pen-test-bot: upload-event observed for prefix 4890123456. Validations: sha256 matches, allowed mime-types (application/gzip, text/csv, application/json), manifest.sig present. Creating manifest and signing with upload-key. :white_check_mark:

neha: One request 5: include note about retention and allowed access list (which assessor accounts can access the presigned URLs). We should document exact principal emails.

li: I'll include the ACL in the manifest and a single presigned URL that expires in 7 days. Example presign:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4890123456/audit.gz --expires-in 604800
```

sam: I'll also attach the terraform plan snippet to show the exact binding change and the change-id so we can map it to deploy logs. File names: rbac.csv, session-policy.json, terraform-plan.txt.

marta: Owners: RBAC & plan = sam, audit exports & presigns = li, KMS manifest = ellen, repros & scrub rules = neha, final packaging + ticket attachment = me. Retest scheduled Wed 10:00 UTC. Please ping if any blocker. :thumbsup:

pen-test-bot: Manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/4890123456/manifest.json (presigned) - manifest.sig present. Runbook note: verify manifest.sig before download. :lock:

marta: Closing thread, I'll attach manifest to the PT ticket and mark owners in the retest checklist. Thanks everyone.
